title: MDS Legendary 2027 — flights, Marrakech–Ouarzazate transfers and return
claims: Transfers to Ouarzazate are organised from Marrakech on 31 March and 1 April; participants can also fly directly to Ouarzazate and reach their hotel on their own.
The return bus from Ouarzazate to Marrakech leaves at 06:00 on 12 April; a return flight from Marrakech should be booked after 14:00.
Participants book their own Ouarzazate hotel nights according to arrival date; the event's local travel partner can assist.

verification.checkedVia: web search result + official Legendary 2027 page
verification.note: Official Legendary 2027 page read; this is the April event, not the October MDS 120.
